description: This file defines the ContentInfoActivity class, which is an Android activity responsible for displaying detailed information about a specific content item, such as a TV show or movie. It sets up the UI elements, populates them with data from a ContentItem object or sample data, and handles user interactions including focus changes and back navigation.

classes.name: ContentInfoActivity
classes.description: An Android activity that displays detailed information about a content item, including image, title, metadata, and action buttons, with focus handling and time display.

methods.name: onCreate
methods.description: Initializes the activity, sets up views, populates content, and configures system time and focus handling.

methods.name: initializeViews
methods.description: Finds and assigns all required view references for UI elements.

methods.name: populateContent
methods.description: Populates UI with data from a ContentItem instance.

methods.name: populateSampleContent
methods.description: Fills UI with predefined sample content for demonstration.

methods.name: setupSystemDateTime
methods.description: Updates system time and date displays.

methods.name: setupActionButtons
methods.description: Configures icon and label content of action buttons.

methods.name: setupFocusHandling
methods.description: Sets up scale animation for focus change on action buttons.

methods.name: onBackPressed
methods.description: Handles back button press to finish activity.

methods.name: createIntent
methods.description: Creates an intent to launch ContentInfoActivity with a ContentItem.
